data.name: Axay
data.gender_notes: Axay is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Axay is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Akshaya’, which means ‘never-decreasing’. This name is considered auspicious and bestowed with divine blessings of prosperity and good fortune. It is believed that the name Axay brings happiness and success to the bearer. The name Axay carries the meaning “Fortune, Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Axay usually hope their child will grow to embody fortune, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
